question: Which ministry started the Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is__** the Ministry of Labour and Employment**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)** was launched by the **Ministry of Labour and Employment** in 2016.
 
• The scheme aims to incentivize employers for creating new jobs and expanding the formal employment sector.
 
• Under the scheme:
 
 
• The government pays the **Employer's Pension Scheme (EPS) contribution** (which is 8.33% of the employee's salary) for new employees for a period of three years.
 
• This encourages businesses and employers to hire more workers and increase formal employment, leading to greater job creation in the country.
 
• It is especially focused on benefiting small and medium enterprises by easing the financial burden of employee contributions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ministry of Home Affairs:
 
 
• This ministry is primarily responsible for maintaining internal security and domestic policy, handling issues like law and order, disaster management, and counter-terrorism.
 
• It oversees the management of India's borders, dealing with border security forces, immigration, and border infrastructure.
 
 
 
• Ministry of Corporate Affairs:
 
 
• It regulates the functioning of corporate entities in India, ensuring compliance with the Companies Act and other corporate laws.
 
• The ministry also oversees issues related to corporate governance, transparency, and ethical practices in businesses, along with managing matters related to Insolvency and Bankruptcy.
 
 
 
• Ministry of Rural Development:
 
 
• This ministry focuses on initiatives to improve the living conditions in rural areas, including schemes like Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) for employment and Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana for rural road infrastructure.
 
• It implements various programs aimed at reducing poverty and empowering rural communities through schemes related to housing, water, and sanitation.
